items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Douglas Daniels. Is that the one you taught? Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: They're some of them with a hose pipe, too. Washboards.

The jug. The jug players. Oh, I used to hear that, but I didn't know them, you know. They're some of them with a hose pipe, too. Washboards. Soapbox for bass. But he doesn't know them. But you don't know them, you didn't know them, eh? No, I didn't know them. They used to have a fence for the reason to play for the open with these. Stools, you know, and there's some time. Every Friday and Saturday, we used to play two or three hours for them in the street. You know, like, get out in the river and all them big…
That's right. That's right. That's right.
